Meeting Date:                 7/21/2021
Sponsor(s):                    Moore (17)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 20-F at 601-659 W 79th St,
                              7901-7909 S Union Ave and 7901-7915 S Lowe Ave
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                               ORDINANCE


  BEJT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

  SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
  is hereby amended by changing all ofthe Bl-2 and Ml-2 District symbols and indications
  as shown on Map No. 20-F in the area bounded by

         West 79th Street; the public alley next south oTand parallel to West 79th Street;
         South Lowe Avenue; a line 153.50 feet south of West 79th Street; the westerly line
         ofthe Commuter Rail Division of the Regional Transportation Authority railroad
         nght-of-way (formerly the Chicago, Rock Island & Pacific Railroad right-of-way);
         a line 218.47 feet south of West 79th Street as measured along the westerly line of
         the Commuter Rail Division of the Regional Transportation Authority railroad
         right-of-way (fonneriy the Chicago, Rock Island & Pacific Railroad right-of-way);
         a line 248.09 feet south of West 79th Street as measured along the easterly line of
         the Commuter Rail Division of the Regional Transportation Authority railroad
         right-of-way (fonneriy the Chicago, Rock Island & Pacific Railroad right-of-way);
         and the easteriy line of the Commuter Rail Division of the Regional Transportation
         Authority railroadright-of-way(fonneriy the Chicago, Rock Island & Pacific
         Railroad right-of-way)

   to those of a T Transportation District.

   SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
   publication.




                                        David Moore
                                        Alderinifn, 17th Ward
